style: The site as a crawler reads it, printed in two riso inks on cool white: wide Mona Sans headlines in blue with a pink misregistration, Spline Sans Mono request lines (GET /services 200) heading every section, a sitemap the crawler walks in the hero, services as a branch of the tree, process as three crawl depths and contact as submitting a site.

concept.idea: Search and AI visibility starts with being readable, so the agency's own site is drawn as a crawler sees it: a sitemap, request lines and status codes, with the crawler shown walking it.
concept.signature: In the hero sitemap a crawler dot walks the site depth first, down each branch and back up, lighting every page pink as it reaches it, then starts again. Every page is drawn as reached without JS or with reduced motion.
concept.motionVerb: crawl: hop along a link, light the page, move on

jury.note: Self-score against the /jury rubric from the previews (desktop, phone, long.json); no critic agent was run for this batch. The strongest poster of the batch: wide blue Mona Sans with a pink riso misregistration, and a hero sitemap the crawler visibly walks. Request lines on every section carry the idea through the page. Usability held at 7.5 because the mono path labels and status pills ask a little of a non-technical reader. The diagram is captioned as a diagram, not data.
